answer: Because the grove cliff is fixed at deposit and published in the beacon ledger, the wharf audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 14 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. A farm of 242 pays that 21 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
